newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Balongan refinery to restart on Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Balongan refinery to restart on Nov 27.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Wednesday its 125,000-barrels-per-day (bpd) Balongan refinery was expected to resume operations on November 27 or 28 after a maintenance shutdown from October 1.
"The Balongan refinery seems to be on schedule to resume operations on November 27 or 28," Pertamina junior processing director Samto Utomo told reporters.
He said the refinery, located in West Java, had been undergoing routine maintenance since October.
"There have been no problems (during the maintenance) at the refinery...everything is fine so far," he said.
